abstract: Connections between chronic stress, inflammation, and human diseases are well-established but poorly understood. In this issue of Cell Genomics, the effects of stress hormones on the immune system are investigated using single-cell RNA sequencing to better understand how stress-regulated immunological signaling contributes to disease.
